visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Pictures That Fit the Screen
visualizerParams.description: Type a picture that never grows wider than the screen. The picture is an inline SVG, which is sized like an image. max-width 100% caps the width to the container and height auto keeps the proportions.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<style>
  svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
</style>
<svg viewBox="0 0 800 400" width="800" height="400">
  <rect width="800" height="400" fill="teal"/>
</svg>

checks.label: The picture keeps its 2 to 1 shape
The page does not scroll sideways
On a wide screen the picture is at most 800px wide
